cache_dir.description: Cache intermediate build files (namely FROM images)

block.description: Build and store an OCI image

add_env.description: Add these environment variables when running command in container

arch.description: Defaults to `from` image architecture. Required if `from` omitted.

clear_env.description: User to use if pushing generated image to remote

dest.description:
Where to send generated image; skopeo-style reference, see <https://github.com/containers/image/blob/main/docs/containers-transports.5.md> for a full list. This is a pattern - you can add the following strings which will be replaced with generated information:

* `{hash}` - A sha256 sum of all the information used to generate the image (note: this should be stable but has no formal specification and is unrelated to the pushed manifest hash).

* `{short_hash}` - The first hex digits of the hash

dest_host.description: Override the docker daemon host when using the `docker-daemon` transport. Takes a URL (like `unix:///var/run/docker.sock`)

dest_password.description: Password to use if pushing generated image to remote

dest_user.description: User to use if pushing generated image to remote

dest.description: Where to create the dir in the image

mode.description: File mode in octal, defaults to 0755

dirs.description: Dirs to create in the image. This is mostly to explicitly set the file mode of intermediate directories.

dest.description: Where to place the file in the image; defaults to filename of source in image root

mode.description: File mode in octal, defaults to 0644

source.description: Local file to include in image

files_hash.description: A hash of the input files, before building the image

from.description: FROM image to base generated image on; skopeo-style reference, see <https://github.com/containers/image/blob/main/docs/containers-transports.5.md> for a full list. If not specified, has no base layer. This is cached and will only be downloaded once (unless the specifier changes or from_hash is explicitly set to a new value).

from_hash.description: Hash representing the contents of the FROM image, to force re-download even if the specifier doesn't change.

from_host.description: Override the docker daemon host when using the `docker-daemon` transport. Takes a URL (like `unix:///var/run/docker.sock`)

from_password.description: Password to use if pulling FROM image from remote

from_user.description: User to use if pulling FROM image from remote

hash.description: Addressable content hash of the pushed image manifest in a format `algo:hex` like `sha256:0123abcd...`

os.description: Defaults to `from` image os. Required if `from` omitted.

stop_signal.description: Signal to use to stop command in container when shutting down

user.description: User to run command as in container; defaults to user in FROM image

working_dir.description: Working dir for command in container; defaults to working dir in FROM image
